name: New Relic
description: Monitor New Relic alert policies, APM applications, and notification channels for observability compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Sign in to New Relic (one.newrelic.com, or one.eu.newrelic.com for EU accounts).
2. Open the user menu (bottom left) > API keys.
3. Click 'Create a key', choose key type 'User', name it (e.g. 'Comp AI'), and create it.
4. Copy the key (it starts with NRAK-) and paste it below.
5. Set Region to EU if you sign in at one.eu.newrelic.com; otherwise leave it as US. The wrong region causes authentication failures.

credentialFields.label: API Key
credentialFields.helpText: Create a User API Key under your New Relic profile > API keys

credentialFields.label: Data center region
credentialFields.helpText: Select EU if your New Relic account is hosted in the EU (you sign in at one.eu.newrelic.com); otherwise select US. Choosing the wrong region causes authentication (HTTP 403) errors.
